what is the student check-out policy?.question: What is the student check-out policy?

variants.answer:
Here is the current student check-out policy at Vista Ridge High School for the 2026-2027 school year:

- Parents/guardians must come to the office in person with a photo ID to check their student out early. Phone calls for early dismissal are not accepted for student safety.
- Students must sign in/out at the Attendance Window when leaving or returning to campus.
- If using email or notes for early dismissal:
  - Notes/emails should include the student's full legal name, ID number, grade, exact dismissal time, and reason for dismissal.
  - Emails sent before 10:30 AM can be used for student check-out at any time later that day.
  - After the absence, follow-up notes documenting the reason for early check-out are required to excuse the absence.
- Please arrive at least 20 minutes before you need your student to be released due to high request volume.
- In-person early check-outs are not allowed after 2:45 PM. After this time, you must wait for regular dismissal.
- All students must sign out when leaving and sign back in if they return.

For a complete overview, visit: [How To Check Your Student Out Early](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhsattendance/student-sign-out).

Let me know if you need any more details!
